records.claim: The use of propranolol in late pregnancy might increase the chance for the baby to have symptoms of beta-blockade. These symptoms can appear shortly after birth and include slowed heart rate, low blood pressure, and low blood sugar. Not all babies exposed to propranolol will have these symptoms. It is important for your healthcare providers to know if you are taking propranolol so that your baby can get the care that is best for them.
records.source_section: Does taking propranolol in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
